findings.message: Entry params colaboradorId, categoria and page filter despesasAprovadasLista but no state holds them. Added persisted public states colaboradorId, categoria and page (filters of listarDespesasAprovadas); listarDespesasAprovadas(options) publishes them and loads from the first page when a filter changes.

selectedDespesa (entry.params.despesaId) holds only the id and no setter existed. The request method obterDespesaAprovada(id | null) acts as the selection: it publishes selectedDespesa, clears and then loads the record into despesa; null clears the selection.
The registroPagamentoForm has no <command>.input state. Added the registrarPagamentoDraft state (RegistrarPagamentoDraft with details.dataPagamento) with its setter setRegistrarPagamentoDraft.

registrarPagamento returns the paid despesa. It redraws despesa and selectedDespesa and removes the item from despesas.items (it is no longer approved). Nothing in the output updates the list pager or hasMore, and pageStatus stays unchanged even if the list becomes empty.
public categoria is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
